title: Qistas: A Pre-Registered, Portable Protocol for Fairness Evaluation of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.40893v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fairness benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) are overwhelmingly English-born and American in their social categories; translated versions carry those categories into societies where they do not apply, and almost none fix their hypotheses before the models are run. We present Qistas (Arabic qistas, "the just balance"), a protocol for evaluating how LLMs treat the social, confessional, and regional constituencies of a society, portable across countries and instantiated first for Iraq. In its pilot form it measures only what needs no verdict on contested truth: procedural symmetry across matched counterfactual pairs, differential refusal, stereotype reliance under ambiguity, and terminological framing of documented events. translated_title: Qistas：一种用于大语言模型公平性评估的预注册、可移植协议
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的公平性基准测试绝大多数诞生于英语世界，其社会类别带有浓厚的美国色彩；翻译版本会将这些类别强行带入并不适用的社会，而且几乎没有基准在运行模型之前预先固定其假设。我们提出了Qistas（阿拉伯语“قistas”，意为“公正的天平”），这是一个评估大语言模型如何对待一个社会的社会、教派和地区群体的协议，可跨国移植，并首先在伊拉克落地实施。在其试点形式中，它仅测量那些无需对争议性真相作出裁决的内容：匹配反事实对之间的程序对称性、差异性拒绝、模糊情境下的刻板印象依赖，以及对有记录事件的术语框定。每一项测量在构造上都是配对的，并使用配对分析工具进行分析（符号翻转置换检验、精确McNemar检验、模板聚类自助法置信区间、经Holm校正的检验族），同时进行统计功效分析……
tldr: 提出了Qistas——一个预注册、可跨国移植的大语言模型公平性评估协议，通过配对反事实设计与严格的统计检验来衡量模型对一个社会不同社会、教派和地区群体处理的程序公平性，并首先在伊拉克落地实施。
en_tdlr: Qistas is a pre-registered, portable protocol for evaluating LLM fairness toward a society's social, confessional, and regional groups, using matched counterfactual pairs and rigorous paired statistical analyses, first instantiated for Iraq.
